notes: §2002:12.3.4.7.2 SR2: data-name-1 'shall be a two-character data item of the category alphanumeric, defined in the working-storage, local-storage, or linkage section'. Accepted leg: WS, LS and linkage items each receive 35 from OPEN INPUT of an absent non-optional file (§2002:9.1.12.5 item 4; stored per §2002:12.3.4.7.3 GR1): WS=35, LOCAL=35, CALLER SEES 35. Refused leg: the same shape of item in a record under a CD (communication section, not in the list) shall be refused at the FILE STATUS clause, line 22. g2fst01 at --std 2002: exit 0, output equals the derived 3 lines (MATCH). g2fst02 at --std 2002: exit 65, error COBOL2455 at (22,31) 'FILE STATUS CFS is defined in the communication section', plus the COBOL0903 obsolete warning: equals the derived refusal.
